faqs.q: Is HDFC Millennia better than Amazon Pay ICICI?

faqs.q: What happens after I hit the ₹1,000 monthly cap?
faqs.a: The named-merchant and other eligible purchase buckets each have a 1,000-CashPoint calendar-month cap. When you exhaust the 5% bucket, further purchases in that bucket do not switch to 1%. capMath.title: Select earns by category and caps rewards at your credit limit
